programmes.t: Super Senses S1 - "Hearing"
programmes.d: On this episode we travel from the desert, to the forest, Australia to Borneo and back to learn how species as diverse as Bat-eared Foxes, the Bilby, Deer, Kangaroo Rats, cicadas, Proboscis Monkeys and other creatures never miss an auditory trick.

programmes.t: Super Senses S1 - "Touch"
programmes.d: On this episode of Animal Super Senses, we get in touch with the feelings of wild animals. Really in touch. Because animals, just like humans, rely heavily on their sense of touch, every day in every way.

programmes.t: Super Senses S1 - "Taste and Smell"
programmes.d: On this episode of Animal Super Senses, we examine how things taste, and how vital scent is from the animal perspective. But their sense of smell will also detect the scent of odorants carried through the air.

programmes.t: Super Senses S1 - "Superhuman Senses"
programmes.d: There are senses we share with most animals, but what about those senses that human is equipped with? Infrared light, electromagnetic waves and ultrasound, are all found within a spectrum of sensory information that just passes by ordinary humans.

programmes.t: Super Senses S1 - "Sixth Sense"
programmes.d: There’s a whole world and more than one spectrum of sensations that animals are aware of, yet which just pass humans by. There’s a kind of “sixth sense” that some animals have which still defies explanation.

programmes.t: Super Senses S1 - "Sense of Timing"
programmes.d: In this episode, we examine how every animal has what could be called a sense of rhythm – the human animal included. To give an obvious example, there’s our internal body clock which responds to the so-called Circadian rhythm.

programmes.t: Super Senses S1 - "Underwater"
programmes.d: While all life began in the oceans, human beings now rely on technology to navigate the seven seas – left to our own devices; we’re like the proverbial fish out of water. Only the other way around.

programmes.t: Super Senses S1 - "Sky"
programmes.d: Animals that live life on the wing, have a vast expanse of sky to navigate, find mates, locate food, and avoid predators in… Living in this aerial realm requires a unique set of senses, specialized to cope with life above ground…

programmes.t: Super Senses S1 - "Night"
programmes.d: We find out about the animals that live in the shadows and the adaptations they need to survive. Nocturnal animals have taken to this dark world for good reason. You need some special abilities to cope with the lack of light.

programmes.t: Super Senses S1 - "Earth"
programmes.d: We find out more about the animals that have their feet firmly planted on or under the ground. And find out how their senses are tuned to survive. What we see above the ground is only a small part of the natural world.

programmes.t: Super Senses S1 - "Communication"
programmes.d: Animals use communication to attract mates,warn off predators, defend territory, or trick their prey. And of course, it’s the senses that play the key role - Sight, smell, taste, touch, and hearing - all are employed to send signals to others.

programmes.t: Super Senses S1 - "The Most Amazing Senses"
programmes.d: In this last episode of Super Senses we take the grand final tour to see the greatest of all the special weapons that help some animals to govern the wilderness. In this episode we see it, hear it, touch it, smell it and taste it like animals do.

programmes.t: Miracle Materials S1 - "From Concrete to Clay"
programmes.d: Innovators reimagine building materials using textile-reinforced concrete, ancient Roman techniques, and 3D-printed clay structures.

programmes.t: Miracle Materials S1 - "From Wood to Bamboo"
programmes.d: Architects harness rapidly renewable resources like timber, transparent wood, bamboo, and mycelium fungi to construct future cities.

programmes.t: Miracle Materials S1 - "Living Bridges And Fiber Constructions"
programmes.d: Hybrid architecture integrates living trees and resource-efficient fiber designs to cool urban centers and transform modern building.

programmes.t: Steel Monsters S1 - "Mega Towing"
programmes.d: Specialized XXL tow units execute high-risk rescue missions, retrieving heavy military vehicles and towing the world's largest aircraft.

programmes.t: Heavy Lifting S1 - "Just Like Downtown"
programmes.d: Dave deals with a messy train, J.P. takes down a tree, Regional Crane lifts a huge wall, and Maxum Crane moves a couch to a high-rise.

programmes.t: Heavy Lifting S1 - "Taking out the Trash"
programmes.d: Dave faces a tricky residential lift, J.P. races between last-minute jobs, and Brad and Nathan Moore help a family’s dream come true.

programmes.t: How Do They Do It S13 - "Baklava/Gyroplane/Ukulele"
programmes.d: How do they make baklava, the favourite sweet of the Ottomans? How do they fly a gyroplane, James Bond’s vehicle of choice? How do they craft a ukulele, the Hawaiian instrument played by Elvis? How do they build a supercat, the world’s fastest ferry?

programmes.t: How Do They Do It S13 - "Longboards/Lemonade/Forklifts"
programmes.d: How do they carve longboards, the skateboard’s bigger, faster brother? How do they turn tonnes of lemons into millions of bottles of lemons? How do they build industry’s versatile heavy lifter, the forklift truck?

programmes.t: How Do They Do It S13 - "Coffee/Bricks/Lavalamps/Diamonds"
programmes.d: How do they roast the coffee that wakes up Italy? How do they bake the bricks that build America? How do they heat the oil that fills lava lamps? How do they blast diamonds from a frozen volcano?

programmes.t: How Do They Do It S13 - "Cameras/Big Airbags/ Jelly Beans"
programmes.d: How do they take the world’s sharpest photos? How do they stitch an airbag that can catch a falling car? How do they make billions of perfect jelly beans?

programmes.t: How Do They Do It S13 - "Caravans/Tuning Forks/Ice Resurfacer/Festival of Lights"
programmes.d: How do they build a caravan that’s tougher than an SUV? How do they forge tuning forks to provide musicians with perfect pitch? How do they resurface an ice rink in minutes? How do they put on the world’s biggest festival of lights?

programmes.t: How Do They Do It S13 - "Vinyl Records/Bumper Cars/Tiger Balm"
programmes.d: How do they make the world’s grooviest music, the vinyl LP? How do they build the world’s most crashed car, the dodgem? How do they create one of the world’s oldest pain remedies, tiger balm?

programmes.t: How Do They Do It S13 - "Alcohol Free Beer/Tomcars/Escalators/Lie Detectors"
programmes.d: How do they brew a beer that won’t make you drunk? How do they build a car that flies over rocks and boulders? How do they bolt together an escalator that will carry millions every year? How do they bust criminals with a lie detector?

programmes.t: How Do They Do It S13 - "Axes/Messenger Bags/Fast Rescue Boats"
programmes.d: How do they forge one of the greatest inventions of all time, the axe? How do they cut, sew, stitch and glue together a courier’s messenger bag? How do they build the world’s fastest lifeboats?

programmes.t: How Do They Do It S13 - "Wensleydale Cheese/Paintbrushes/Eucalyptus Oil/Plastic Wrap"
programmes.d: How do they do Wallace and Gromit’s cheese of choice, Wensleydale? How do they turn pig hair into paintbrushes? How do they distill aromatic oils from the koala’s favourite food, eucalyptus? How do they make the plastic that keeps your food fresh?

programmes.t: Xploration Outer Space S3 - "Surviving Space"
programmes.d: Host Emily Calandrelli visits NASA’s Swamp Works, which tests space suits and machines for Mars-like conditions.

programmes.t: Xploration Outer Space S3 - "Engineering Space"
programmes.d: Host Emily Calandrelli visits four types of engineers who are on the cutting edge of aerospace technology.

programmes.t: Xploration Outer Space S3 - "A Satellite’s Eye View"
programmes.d: Join host Emily Calandrelli as we look at satellites that will provide us with instant images of our planet and bring high-speed internet to every human on Earth.

programmes.t: Xploration Outer Space S3 - "The Art of Space"
programmes.d: Four artists display their unique methods of illustrating the mysterious frontier of outer space. Host, Emily Calandrelli tries spray painting as well.

programmes.t: The Aviators S2 - "Triple Tree Aerodrome"
programmes.d: A look at one of the most meticulously maintained grass runways anywhere at what we discovered to be a pure haven for lovers of aviation and the outdoors. All aboard Fat Albert Airlines, the Blue Angels’ incredible USMC C130T and Sara meets Peyton McCool and takes a spin (literally) in his Soviet-er

programmes.t: The Aviators S2 - "Dream flight of a lifetime"
programmes.d: Twenty pilots attend a T33 Silverstar ground school but only one will win a chance to actually fly it. We visit the Joe Nall event, the “Oshkosh” of RC flying, and Raeleen goes flying with rock stars of the air show circuit, the Aeroshell Aerobatic Team.

programmes.t: The Aviators S2 - "Aircraft ownership"
programmes.d: Kurtis explores the varied costs and entry points of flying for everyone from the weekend warrior to the rich and famous. When your driveway is a runway, life is good… and as airparks go, this place is Heavenly! Are two engines really better than one?

programmes.t: The Aviators S2 - "Aircraft engines"
programmes.d: Kurtis learns about aircraft power plants from Penn Yan Aero’s Bill Middlebrook, whose family has a long and rich history in American aviation. Anthony shows that buying The Aviators’ new 210 can be just as simple as buying a used car. And accessorizing it can be just as fun. Raeleen celebrates wome

programmes.t: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S2 - "Terry's Underworld"
programmes.d: Terry and Larry are going to test a famous scene from Underworld with Kate Beckensale. Terry will attempt to shoot a circle around himself in the floor and fall through to save himself from the pack of werewolves.

programmes.t: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S3 - "A Pirates Life for Terry"
programmes.d: Terry and Larry go on a swashbuckling adventure when they test two scenes from the 1920’s film, The Black Pirate starring Douglas Fairbanks, Senior. Terry will see if he can knock down a ships mast with a canon, and then test gravity as he slides down a sail with only a knife.

programmes.t: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S3 - "Terry Loves 70's Cop Shows"
programmes.d: Terry travels back in time to the 70’s where he gets to relive his childhood dreams of becoming a 70’s TV cop. Larry helps Terry test several scenarios, including hiding behind a car door for cover, and if you can really shoot a gas tank from a car to make it explode.

programmes.t: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S3 - "Breaking Terry Badly"
programmes.d: Terry falls victim to Walter White in Breaking Bad, and Terry and Larry test 3 separate scenes from this iconic series, 2 of which need the help of Special Effects expert Andre Ellingson, including lighting a gas tank on fire and chemically burning through a steal door.

programmes.t: Xploration Awesome Planet S5 - "Helping Hands"
programmes.d: In this episode, we dive with dozens of bull sharks in Fiji. We then head to South Florida to plant native mangroves in an area of need. The journey ends with a trip to Maui.

programmes.t: Xploration Awesome Planet S5 - "Formations"
programmes.d: In this episode, Cousteau explores some of our planets most incredible natural formations.

programmes.t: Xploration Awesome Planet S5 - "Sports & The Environment"
programmes.d: In this episode, we travel to the intersection of sports and our environment.

programmes.t: Xploration Awesome Planet S5 - "Student Explorer"
programmes.d: In this episode, we reveal the winner of our second ever #StudentExplorer Contest.
